# Navakanipāta (AN 9)

**ID:** AN 9
**Section:** Aṅguttaranikāya (an)
**Collection:** Suttas-Early-1
**Title (Pali):** Navakanipāta

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Navakanipāta* ("The Book of the Nines") is the ninth major division (*nipāta*) of the *Aṅguttaranikāya*, organizing discourses around numerical sets and doctrines categorized under nine items. Key doctrinal themes running through the collection include the progressive nine meditative attainments (*samāpatti*) culminating in the cessation of perception and feeling (*saññāvedayitanirodha*), featured prominently in AN 9.31, the *Jhānasutta* (AN 9.36), and AN 9.41 [Anālayo 2014; Kuznetsova et al. 2012; Shulman 2014]. Other discourses address the ending of the concatenation of karma (*kammanidānasaṅkhaya*) through the eradication of greed, aversion, and delusion (AN 9.13) [IABU 2012], bodily contemplation to overcome lust in the *Gaṇḍasutta* (AN 9.15) [McMahan 2008], the role of the four *satipaṭṭhāna*s in abandoning the five hindrances (AN 9.64) [Wen 2011], and the karmic value of giving (*dāna*) in the *Velāmasutta* (AN 9.20) [Wen 2011]. Disciplinary matters, such as the suspension of the *uposatha*, also find parallels in Vinaya traditions [Lueritthikul 2015].

 DharmaNexus computes 37,994 Pali-internal reuse passages across 543 texts, demonstrating substantial shared formulaic material with neighboring numerical books (AN 10, AN 4, AN 3, AN 5, AN 8) and *Saṁyutta* collections (SN 47, SN 12, SN 40, SN 35, SN 55), as well as the *Saṅgīti Sutta* (DN 33) [DharmaNexus]. Furthermore, DharmaNexus aligns passages of AN 9 with Sanskrit and Tibetan works, including the *Daśottarasūtra*, the *Arthaviniścayasūtra*, the *Saṅghabhedavastu*, the Sarvāstivāda *Dharmaskandha*, and *Prajñāpāramitā* texts, reinforcing the doctrinal alignments identified in the Chinese Āgamas [DharmaNexus].
